issues.title: Model has no mass assignment policy
issues.message: Neither $fillable nor $guarded is defined, so mass-assignment protection is implicit and easy to miss during review.
issues.recommendation: Add an explicit $fillable list for request-driven writes, or define $guarded when the model never receives mass-assigned input.

issues.title: env() used outside config
issues.message: Laravel configuration caching can make env() unavailable outside config files.
issues.recommendation: Move environment reads into config files and use config() throughout application code.

issues.recommendation: Use Illuminate\Http\Request, request(), or typed route parameters instead of superglobals.
